messages:
maria (prod-eng): :rotating_light: BigBank getting 503s hitting their dedicated pool, started ~09:02 UTC, spike at 09:05. CS escalated. Need owners + immediate mitigation plan.

zheng (eng-platform): I'll take lead on the routing fallback. Can we route low-priority requests to model-v1-legacy? That's compatible.

riley (sre): Are these 503s originating from queue backlog or model OOMs? Logs show 'worker_timeout' in pool-23.

maria (prod-eng): SRE saw increased tail latency and queue growth. After 30s requests get 503.

tom (runtime): Confirmed: kv-cache pressure + autoscaler didn't kick due to mis-configured threshold. Patch incoming.

maria (prod-eng): Proposed immediate actions:
- zheng: enable fallback route to model-v1-legacy for BigBank (<=5m)
- tom: hotfix autoscaler threshold (PR + rolling deploy <=30m)
- riley: increase pool min nodes by +2 (manual) to cover spike
- avni (cs): notify customer ETA 1h

zheng (eng-platform): I'll flip fallback rule now. pinging @deploy-bot to do canary.

deploy-bot: deploy request received for "fallback-route:bigbank". Canary start -> pods: 2 -> status: initializing

riley (sre): Scaling up pool min nodes now. ETA ~7m.

tom (runtime): PR: https://git.redwood.org/r/redwood/runtime/+/12345
Need reviews from @zheng and @maria. Tests run in CI.

maria (prod-eng): @zheng confirm when fallback is live so CS can tell customer.

zheng (eng-platform): Fallback live. Observability -> routed ~60% traffic to legacy variant, errors dropped from 12% -> 1.8% :thumbsup:

avni (cs): Messaging customer now. I'll say: mitigation applied, engineering working on permanent fix, ETA 2 hours for full resolution.

riley (sre): Autoscaler patch deployed to canary, monitoring p99 latency. Rolling to regional pools.

maria (prod-eng): tom, if autoscaler patch goes green, can you revert manual +2 once stable? Keep me posted.

tom (runtime): Yep. Will remove manual scale after 15m stable. PR merged, canary green.

riley (sre): Manual nodes removed. p50/p95/p99 improved. Marking severity lowered to P2 in incident tracker.

maria (prod-eng): Thank you all. Action items:
- tom: postmortem draft (initial) by EOD
- zheng: ensure fallback rule added to runbook + test
- riley: verify autoscaler alert thresholds
- avni: close CS loop after final confirmation

maria (prod-eng): If anyone needs to add owners or blockers, reply here. :eyes:

sre-oncall: Incident updated: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-2043
